title: Prohibit Ambient RNG In Authored Generation
forbids: map-domain or recipe source acquiring ambient randomness, calling Civ7 generators outside its declared step engine capability, or importing MapGen's private RNG implementation
why: Authored generation is deterministic dataflow. Randomness comes from explicit seed-derived operation inputs, while sanctioned Civ7 generators are reachable only through the step engine capability selected by the step contract.
remediate: Derive randomness from the operation's admitted seed, invoke an authorized Civ7 generator through deps.engine, and depend on public MapGen authoring contracts rather than private RNG implementation modules.
message: Authored map generation must keep randomness and Civ7 generator access explicit.
